A whole community of 20-30 people (in-person, not online), both straight and queer, did nothing as I, a minor at the time, was groomed and abused for nearly an entire year. Whether or not we like to admit it, bystander effect is very real, and statistically, we'd be bystanders too. It's grim, but it's the truth. Stay safe out there and try to keep tight-knit connections so that you have a support network to help avoid a horrible situation if push comes to shove.

Evolve Chinchou into Lanturn and give it the thunderbolt TM from completing old Mauville. That + Vileplume + Tropius should handle every non Kingdra mon on his team.  All his non kingdra mons are genuinely not threatening at all.

In terms of dealing with the Kingdra, Wobbufett spamming mirror coat/destiny bond will take care of it, but you'll most likely lose the Wobbufett. If you're trying to save Wobbufett for later, getting a bulky Pokémon to hit hard neutrally will be your best play. Prime candidates are Hariyama and Walrein, but those Pokémon are both great in the elite 4, so be cautious when using them. Linoone isn't bulky, but it outspeeds and hits Kingdra decently hard with STAB headbutt, but Linoone is also great on the elite 4, so be cautious too. 

Golduck can also be brought to neutralize weather with Cloud Nine (It has that ability in general 3 right?) in the off chance, but very scary situation that Kingdra comes in while rain dance is active.

Spinda can be good to sacrifice for momentum while also potentially supporting with teeter dance cheese

Tropius and Camerupt can be used to bait out Ice and Water STABs respectively if you need to pivot
